baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired أَجْرٍ and أَجْرِىَ, with لَكُمْ opposed to عَلَى ٱللَّهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first half raises a possible audience-facing request for work-compensation and immediately assigns it to the audience; the second reserves the speaker's own compensation claim for God. Repetition plus the shift in possession and counterparty separates recipient benefit from speaker entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Asking as a directed demand opens the possibility of a claim against the addressees.
Work-compensation recurs in both halves; the changed possessor and counterparty split one apparent wage relation into two accounts.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply says that he charges no fee.
changed_reading.after: The verse formally separates two accounts: no compensation liability remains on the audience, while the speaker's compensation claim is lodged only with God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The resumptive فَهُوَ لَكُمْ after مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object that could look like a requested wage is predicated as belonging to the hearers. The clause can therefore mark recipient-side yield, not merely speaker-side abstinence: the human value produced by the communication stays with those addressed.

activation_trace.role: The requested object or need makes مَا a candidate object whose destination is then reversed by لَكُمْ.
Compensation supplies the value at issue, while فَهُوَ لَكُمْ assigns its human-side benefit to the recipients.

changed_reading.after: The apparent fee is reclassified as value for the addressees; the speaker does not extract the human-side yield of his work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ immediately follows the compensation claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: Totality, an inspectable matter, presence, and decisive testimony combine to place the speaker's stated financial motive under comprehensive external witness. The close is an evidentiary seal on the disclaimer, not only a general omniscience formula.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing all parts removes any unobserved remainder from the wage claim.
Anything knowable and reportable makes the speaker's motive one matter within the witness's scope.
Presence with observation supplies direct oversight of the declared compensation arrangement.
Knowledge-bearing testimony turns oversight into evidence capable of deciding whether the disclaimer is true.

changed_reading.before: The witness clause is a generic statement of divine knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The witness clause audits the no-fee claim and exposes any hidden pecuniary motive to decisive testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The matched construction in 34:39 presents value leaving through expenditure, returning by replacement, and remaining inside divine provision. Applied to 34:47, the apparent outgoing wage is not captured by the messenger: its yield remains or returns to the addressees, while God carries the speaker's compensation.

activation_trace.role: Work-compensation is the value whose direction the parallel construction reclassifies.
Allotted giving encloses both the initial provision and its final provider, locating replacement within a divine economy.
Value or condition returning after departure supplies the restorative turn behind فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ.
Money going out supplies the apparent loss that divine replacement reverses.

structural_cues: 34:39 and 34:47 share the frame مَا ... مِنْ ... فَهُوَ and both close with وَهُوَ plus a divine predicate.
The earlier clause makes apparent outgoing value return through replacement; the focus clause redirects an apparent wage to لَكُمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spending, replacement, provision, and the matched syntax; I infer that the formal echo transfers a non-loss circulation pattern to the wage clause. A live alternative is that the parallel is rhetorical only and فَهُوَ لَكُمْ is simply a disclaimer.

changed_reading.before: فَهُوَ لَكُمْ only cancels a fee.
changed_reading.after: The fee clause participates in a non-loss economy: value is not extracted by the messenger but remains or returns as the recipients' benefit, while his wage is guaranteed elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: Particle-weight measurement, an obligating record, repayment for work, and guarding of every thing turn comprehensive witnessing into a precision ledger. The speaker's uncompensated human work is neither lost nor self-certified; its account is preserved for divine settlement.

activation_trace.role: Decisive testimony supplies the audit function that the context's measure, record, and guarding specify.
Exact weight supplies an account unit small enough that no work or claim disappears as negligible.
A written fixation that entails judgment supplies durable registration of what is measured.
Repayment corresponding to an act supplies the settlement side of the ledger.
Intentional work supplies the deed whose recompense is registered.
Guarding every thing in the exact عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ frame preserves the account later sealed by شَهِيدٌ.

structural_cues: 34:21 and 34:47 repeat عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ with حَفِيظٌ and شَهِيدٌ as complementary predicates.
34:3 moves from the smallest and largest measures into a clear record, and 34:4 immediately names repayment for work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, record, work-repayment, guarding, and testimony; I infer a ledger function linking them to the speaker's wage. The alternative is that each predicate states general knowledge without a specific compensation-accounting role.

changed_reading.before: God witnesses the fee disclaimer in a broad sense.
changed_reading.after: God's witnessing is the audit and custody mechanism for an exact compensation account in which even unpriced human work remains payable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah removes ownership, partnership, backing, and independent benefit from every rival source. Human payment would create a possible patronal claim on the messenger; placing his wage solely upon God blocks that leverage and protects the message from sponsor capture.

activation_trace.role: Contractual compensation supplies the relation through which a human payer could otherwise acquire leverage.
Ownership and disposal are denied to rival powers, removing an alternate source with a claim over outcomes.
Partnership is denied, sharpening the exclusivity of the compensation counterparty in 34:47.
Back-strength and support are denied to the rivals, excluding hidden patronal backing.
The denial of one party's power to benefit another exposes the limits of every human patronage relation.

structural_cues: 34:22 denies possession, share, and backing in a single sequence; 34:47 answers with one exclusive compensation counterparty.
34:42 later denies reciprocal control of benefit and harm, preventing human support from becoming ultimate security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied ownership, partnership, backing, and benefit; I add the social arrow that payment can purchase leverage over a speaker. A live alternative is that these divine-power claims do not directly address funding or patronage.

changed_reading.before: The speaker refuses payment as an act of generosity.
changed_reading.after: The speaker refuses a patron-client relation: divine-only compensation is an anti-capture safeguard for the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: An attributed intention to divert the audience is followed by an instruction to separate into independent units, reconsider the familiar companion, and then hear his no-fee declaration. The compensation statement becomes evidence in a motive test: an extractive aim is less able to explain speech that yields no human wage.

activation_trace.role: The absent human compensation supplies the observation against which the alleged motive is tested.
Will and intention supply the opponents' motive claim that the speaker wants to turn the audience away.
Separation into an independent unit interrupts crowd-level reinforcement during the inquiry.
Repeated movement of the heart over the evidence supplies the actual motive-testing operation.
Long companionship supplies observed conduct against which accusations and financial incentives can be checked.

structural_cues: 34:43 states the alleged intention; 34:46 orders reflection in pairs and singly; 34:47 immediately discloses the compensation arrangement.
The repeated imperative قُلْ turns the no-fee clause into part of the public evidentiary sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an alleged motive, independent reflection, familiar conduct, and no human wage; I infer that the wage disclosure is offered as evidence against self-interested intent. The live alternative is that lack of payment weakens one accusation but cannot establish the message's truth.

changed_reading.before: The no-fee statement is a detached personal disclaimer.
changed_reading.after: The no-fee statement is a falsifiable datum in the audience's independent examination of the speaker's motive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal questioning keeps each side's acts on its own account; later, error remains on the speaker's own self while guidance is sourced in revelation. This revises the compensation split into an agency boundary: neither fee nor allegiance transfers moral responsibility between messenger and hearers.

activation_trace.role: The focus ask opens an audience-facing claim that the surrounding accountability pattern then limits.
Compensation provides the transaction that is prevented from carrying agency across the boundary.
Reciprocal questioning assigns each side's inquiry to the other side's own deeds rather than pooling liability.
Intentional work supplies the conduct retained on the addressees' side of the account.
The self as the very person localizes the consequence of error instead of transferring it to the audience.
Divine communication supplies the source of guidance, paralleling God as the source of the speaker's wage.

structural_cues: 34:25 uses reciprocal second- and first-person questioning to separate deeds; 34:47 uses the same root while separating compensation.
34:50 balances عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى against what the Lord reveals, echoing لَكُمْ against عَلَى ٱللَّهِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separated questioning, self-bound error, and divinely sourced guidance; I infer that the economic separation in 34:47 also protects nontransferable agency. A live alternative is that accountability and compensation are adjacent but independent topics.

changed_reading.before: The verse separates only who pays whom.
changed_reading.after: The verse also guards an agency boundary: payment cannot buy guidance, transfer responsibility, or make the messenger answerable to the audience as a hired proxy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The boast of abundant wealth is denied as a route to divine nearness, while faithful work receives multiplied recompense. The focus verse relocates the messenger's wage into that same value scale: market payment is not the measure of proximity or worth.

activation_trace.role: Compensation is the value term whose measuring system changes from human wealth to divine recompense.
Accumulated wealth supplies the rejected social metric of security and standing.
Nearness supplies the outcome that wealth cannot purchase.
Act-matched recompense supplies the alternative valuation of faithful work.
Increase by a matching multiple makes divine recompense exceed the flat human fee scale.

structural_cues: 34:35 states the wealth boast; 34:37 denies wealth as nearness and replaces it with recompense for work.
34:47 repeats the compensation domain but assigns the messenger's claim only to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, failed nearness, work, and multiplied recompense; I infer that the focus's payer shift also rejects wealth as the relevant scale of the message's worth. The alternative is a narrower reading limited to the messenger's personal disinterest.

changed_reading.before: The messenger declines a market fee.
changed_reading.after: The messenger declines the market's scale of value: neither the message's worth nor his standing is priced by the audience's wealth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant broken-bone sense of أجر and couples it to tearing and linked piercing elsewhere in the surah. It remains anchored in the repeated focus root and exact material branches, but downstream prose should present it as a repair analogy, not as the lexical translation of أَجْر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated أَجْرٍ / أَجْرِىَ through the branch جبر الكسر على عوج.

activation_trace.role: Setting a broken member, even when it heals with residual crookedness, supplies a material repair image inside the reward root.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the damaged condition that would require repair.
Piercing and linking rings or hide supplies the concrete operation of reconnecting separated parts.
The repeated tearing image extends material rupture into communal dispersal.

changed_reading.before: أجر names payment for completed work.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the message is repair work on a torn body or community; its human-side reward is the hearers' restored coherence, while the repairer's compensation remains with God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the packet's split mapping from س ء ل to س ل ل, so it is deliberately form-distant. It remains anchored at سَأَلْتُكُم and the wage construction and is reinforced by money leaving and returning in 34:39; render it only as an anti-extraction resonance, not as a replacement for the ordinary sense of asking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَأَلْتُكُم read through the supplied س ل ل branches beside مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out gently and quietly supplies the image of extraction that the sentence disclaims.
Secret taking sharpens the outlier from overt fees to concealed rent or appropriation.
Compensation keeps the extraction image tied to the focus's economic relation.
Money going out supplies the value flow that covert extraction would exploit.
Value returning after departure reverses extraction and supports the claim that the value remains theirs.

changed_reading.before: The speaker declines an explicit invoice.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speaker disclaims every quiet way of drawing value out of the audience; even the value that appears to leave is returned to their side.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is unusual because it activates the tongue-witness branch of ش ه د and joins it to the next verse's hurled speech. It remains tightly anchored by the opening قُلْ and closing شَهِيدٌ, but downstream prose should qualify it as a performative speech mechanism rather than identify the divine witness with a human tongue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus begins with قُلْ and ends with شَهِيدٌ, whose inventory includes اللسان الشاهد.

activation_trace.role: Audible production makes the compensation claim a public utterance rather than a private intention.
The witnessing tongue turns the utterance itself into exposed evidence about the speaker's motive.
Casting speech supplies an active outward trajectory for the truth immediately after the witnessed declaration.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies what the public utterance is sent to bear.

changed_reading.before: The speaker reports a private fact about his compensation and then invokes a witness.
changed_reading.after: The commanded declaration itself becomes public evidence: the tongue exposes the no-fee claim, and the following speech sends truth outward under that witness.

strongest_changes: The near-isomorphic spending and replacement syntax of 34:39 turns fee renunciation into recipient-side, non-loss value circulation.
The measure, record, repayment, and exact عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ parallel turn divine witnessing into a precision compensation ledger.
The denials of rival ownership, partnership, backing, and benefit make divine-only compensation an anti-patronage safeguard.
The accusation and independent-reflection sequence of 34:43-46 makes the no-fee claim evidence in a motive test.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the two occurrences of أجر operate as separate accounts and also exposed repair, covert-extraction, and utterance-as-witness branches that a single consensus paraphrase would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: فَهُوَ لَكُمْ may denote a literal fee retained or returned, the benefit of the message, or both.
The 34:39 syntactic echo may intentionally import replacement logic, or it may be rhetorical recurrence without a shared economic mechanism.
The repair and covert-extraction readings depend on form-distant branches and should remain analogical and explicitly exploratory.
